title: Researching Botanical Record Workflows
description: Investigating source quality, specimen identity and expert review needs before defining a digital herbarium workflow.
question: What must be established about specimen identity, provenance and authentication before digital records can be trusted?
design: Compared the role of external botanical reference sources with locally verified specimen identity; mapped requests, review decisions and authentication responsibilities into a dependable workflow.
focus: Examine reference-source boundaries before integrating lookups
Keep externally suggested identifications separate from expert authentication
Trace requests, physical accession identity and digital record states
Map the questions to ask before technical implementation
reflection: Research does not replace expert judgment; it makes the conditions for using that judgment clearer.
